user.title: Apple Music for Sonos
user.description: Catalog search and playback work straight away. To browse your own library and playlists, paste the `media-user-token` cookie from a signed-in music.apple.com session (browser devtools → Application → Cookies). Leave it empty to skip.

reauth_confirm.title: Apple Music for Sonos
reauth_confirm.description: Apple has rejected the stored music user token, so your library, recently played and recommendations are unavailable. Paste a fresh `media-user-token` cookie from a signed-in music.apple.com session (browser devtools → Application → Cookies). Leave it empty to drop library access and keep catalog search, charts, radio and playback.

simkl_link.title: Scrobble the Apple TV to SIMKL
simkl_link.description: Playback in the Apple TV app can be reported to SIMKL, so episodes you watch there are marked watched. This needs a SIMKL account and nothing else; skip it to leave Apple Music and Infuse exactly as they are.

simkl_pin.title: Approve the code at SIMKL

error.no_developer_token: Could not read a developer token from the Apple Music web player. Apple may have changed it; check the logs.
error.invalid_user_token: Apple rejected that music user token. Copy the `media-user-token` cookie value again from a signed-in session.
error.cannot_connect: Could not reach Apple Music to check the token. Try again once the connection is back.
error.authorization_pending: SIMKL has not seen that code approved yet. Enter it at simkl.com/pin, then press Submit again.

abort.single_instance_allowed: Apple Music for Sonos is already configured.
abort.reauth_successful: Apple Music for Sonos is set up again.

simkl_token_rejected.title: SIMKL has rejected the stored token
simkl_token_rejected.description:
Apple TV playback is not being scrobbled, and every other part of the integration is unaffected.

To fix this, reconfigure the integration from Settings → Devices & Services and link SIMKL again.

no_apple_music_favorite.title: No Apple Music favorite in the Sonos app
no_apple_music_favorite.description:
Playback URIs carry the household's Apple Music account serial, and Sonos only exposes it in URIs its own app has already written. With no Apple Music favorite to read it from, the serial is a guess: items may be added to the queue and then never play, with no error.

To fix this, open the Sonos app and add any Apple Music item — a song, album or playlist — to Sonos Favorites, then play something from here again.
